description: Given any doc (type + slug), the most related content across the whole network, ranked by shared-tag relevance (rare, specific tags weigh most). "More like this," across stories, areas, guidance, papers, conversations, and more.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

slug.description: Slug of the item to find related content for, within `type`, e.g. "2026-09-29-you-cannot-see-your-own-api-from-the-outside".

type.description: Content type of the item `slug` names — the plural path name: posts, services, solutions, tools, areas, papers, videos, conversations, guidance…, e.g. "posts".

types.description: Only return related items of these types, e.g. ["papers","posts"].

name: find_related
